Loading hologram views…

Recognisable broad character shapes remain. The input is reduced to 160px, softened and converted to nine neutral grey tones before rendering at 640px. Original colours and fine detail are discarded; rainbow colour comes from the effect. Brightness and movement settings are unchanged. This is a visual trade-off to judge, not a claim that reconstruction is impossible.

What someone could combine from all the views

We combined the brightest pixels from every view. The character is recognisable. This is one leakage check, not proof against more advanced reconstruction.

These are already-public sample characters. Their originals still exist in earlier demos. This page tests a different delivery method; it does not make those old samples private or implement owner access.

Reconstruction from this version

This rough estimate was recovered from all 81 public views using the same known-renderer test as before, without the clean originals. Treat the visible shapes as public. This one method is not an upper limit on what other techniques could recover or infer.
